feed_items.title: Introducing Aurora 2
feed_items.summary: Aurora 2 is our new flagship model: 2x faster than Aurora 1, 60% cheaper, 1M-token context, native tool calling and a new batch API. Available today in the API and in Nimbus Studio.

feed_items.title: Nimbus Labs launches Aurora 2, its fastest model yet
feed_items.summary: Nimbus Labs released Aurora 2 today, claiming top scores on coding benchmarks and a price cut of 60% versus Aurora 1.

feed_items.title: Nimbus Labs' Aurora 2 undercuts rivals on price
feed_items.summary: Aurora 2 is available via API at $0.40 per million input tokens, with a 1M-token context window.

feed_items.title: Aurora 2 (nimbuslabs.example)
feed_items.summary: Discussion thread: 812 points. Users report strong results on agentic coding tasks.

feed_items.title: First impressions of Aurora 2
feed_items.summary: I ran Aurora 2 through my usual pelican-on-a-bicycle test and a few tool-calling experiments. Notes on pricing and the new batch API.

feed_items.title: [AINews] Aurora 2 day
feed_items.summary: Everything announced in the Aurora 2 launch, plus community reactions and benchmark caveats.

feed_items.title: Tessellate ships open-source eval harness for agent workflows
feed_items.summary: Tessellate released an Apache-2.0 harness to replay and score multi-step agent traces, with built-in LLM-judge rubrics and CI integration.

feed_items.title: How Loomly cut support tickets 40% with an AI triage agent
feed_items.summary: Loomly's PM walks through scoping an AI triage agent, the eval set they built first, and why they launched to 5% of traffic before expanding.

feed_items.title: Quillpad raises $45M Series B for AI note-taking
feed_items.summary: Quillpad, an AI note-taking app, raised a $45M Series B led by a growth fund.

feed_items.title: Speculative decoding without a draft model
feed_items.summary: The paper reuses the model's own early layers as a draft, cutting latency 1.8x with no quality loss on standard benchmarks.
